author: Regina Mobley
title: Residents of VB neighborhood hope worst over after arrests - NewsBreak
text:
By Regina Mobley ,
6 hours ago
VIRGINIA BEACH, Va. (WAVY) — Around the area of 513 Williamsburg Road in the Pembroke Meadows neighborhood, residents are hoping the worst is over.
On a quiet Wednesday morning, Luke Corzine offered a little color commentary on what he reportedly has seen outside the 1960s era home in the recent past.
“In the middle of the night, I’ve seen cars pull up,” Corzine said while unpacking groceries from his car. “Somebody walk out of the house, walk up to the car, go back to the house, the car, pull away. That’s just from what I’ve seen. I can’t make a statement on what it was, but it’s been going downhill.”
Real estate records show the property is owned by Jason Rawlins — that’s the same name as one of 10 suspects who were arrested in connection with trespassing at a Williamsburg Road residence. Rawlins faces drug, ammunition, trespassing and multiple charges associated with weapons. The nine other suspects face lesser charges.
VBPD: 10 arrested in connection with trespassing residence on Williamsburg Road This home has been on the city’s radar for several years. It was condemned last year and, since 2022, there have been 46 calls for service. It was under surveillance Saturday evening when an officer noticed activity around the home.
“I looked out and I saw 16 police cars in the court, a few more in the road,” Corzine said.
Later, armed with warrants, police arrested 10 people. They also confiscated marijuana, white powder residue and a glass pipe that is associated with meth and fentanyl.
In one bedroom, police found ammunition for three handguns, along with one rifle. Some long-term residents say Pembroke Meadows is a neighborhood in decline, but they are grateful police may have solved one problem.
“Thank you, thank you for finally doing something,” Corzine said, adding, “I know the police have to do it their way, and I’m going to assume that they did it the right way.”
Rawlins is due in court Thursday morning for a bond hearing.
